description: Compare two PDFs line by line: extract text with PDF.js, see a side-by-side diff with added/removed lines highlighted, plus change statistics.

faqs.a: The tool compares extracted text, not scanned images. PDFs without a text layer (pure scans) will show as empty.
Long lines are truncated for readability; the diff marks whole changed lines so you can spot differences fast.
Everything runs locally in your browser. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Click "Compare" to extract text and build the diff.
Review added/removed line counts and the side-by-side view.
title: PDF Text Compare
